app.title: SpectraGuard - SERS Spectrum Quality Analyzer
app.summary: A person loads one measured spectrum, either from a CSV/TXT file or as a built-in demo spectrum at a chosen quality level. The interface plots the spectrum with its estimated baseline. It scores the spectrum on six quality metrics, combines them into one weighted confidence score and grade, and shows the breakdown as a radar chart and as per-metric bars. A diagnostics panel gives the raw signal measures behind the scores. The person can then download a plain-text quality report.

task.text: Judge whether one measured spectrum is good enough to use, by scoring it on fixed quality criteria and giving it an overall confidence grade.

data.text: A single measured spectrum: intensity values along a wavenumber axis, with quality scores computed from it.
data.item: one spectrum, as pairs of wavenumber and intensity

stage.text: quality-checking a spectrum right after it is measured, before analysis

mechanism.text: Loading a spectrum in the sidebar recomputes everything on one dashboard page. The spectrum plot with its baseline sits beside a colour-coded overall score and a radar chart of the six metrics. Per-metric bars, an expandable diagnostics panel and a report download sit below.

field.text: spectral quality assessment in SERS and Raman spectroscopy

workflow.name: score one measurement against fixed quality criteria and grade it

steps.here: Upload a CSV/TXT/TSV spectrum. The separator, header and comment lines are detected automatically. Or tick 'Use demo spectrum' and pick Good, Marginal or Bad.
The spectrum is plotted against wavenumber on a reversed axis, with the estimated baseline drawn as a dashed line.

Six metrics are each scored from 0 to 1: SNR, baseline stability, peak reproducibility, resolution (FWHM), fluorescence and hotspot uniformity. They are shown as a radar chart and as colour-coded progress bars.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: The metric scores are combined by weights into a 0–100 confidence score and a grade (Excellent, Good, Marginal or Poor), shown in a coloured badge.

steps.step: look at the measures behind the scores
steps.here: The Diagnostics expander shows the raw SNR, the fluorescence ratio, the average FWHM and the number of peaks detected.
'Download Report (TXT)' saves the score, the grade, each metric's score, the weights, the wavenumber range and the number of points.

distinctive: Six physically interpretable spectral metrics are combined by fixed weights into one 0–100 confidence score, with four grade bands.
An arPLS baseline estimate is drawn over the raw spectrum, which shows the drift that the baseline metric penalises.
Synthetic demo spectra at three preset quality levels let the person watch every metric respond without data.
The wavenumber axis is reversed, following the spectroscopy convention.
